candidates.description: This vector activates on common Hindi suffixes, morphphemes, and sub-word units.
This vector represents subword tokens and characters from Indian languages and scripts.
This vector activates on common Hindi subwords and character sequences, particularly those starting with the consonant 'य' (ya).
This vector activates on the Devanagari retroflex ssa (ष) character and its various vowel combinations and conjunct forms.
This vector represents characters, vowel signs, and consonant conjuncts from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This feature vector activates strongly on character sequences and subwords from the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector represents fragmented fragments of non-English text, including various linguistic scripts, suffixes, and character encodings.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Devanagari character 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and consonant combinations.
This feature vector represents common Hindi characters, sub-word tokens, and punctuation marks used in Devanagari script.
This vector represents common Hindi suffixes, subword tokens, and characters used in word inflection.
